name: TrailNet
input: Sentinel-2 C1 L2A B02,B03,B04,B08 @10m, reflectance clip[0,0.5]/0.25-1

validation.note: vs OpenStreetMap with ±2 px tolerance; OSM is incomplete so precision is understated

training: hard-tile mining (tiles it gets wrong are drawn again until learned) + up to 9x penalty on confidently missed trail pixels; wider U-Net (24-48-96-128)
thresholdNote: 0.63, not the max-F1 0.6 (F1 0.432): nearly the same F1 with fewer stream→trail false hits (0.19 vs 0.22)
